reviews.text: The vet that we saw was really good and saw to our pet swiftly in their emergency care. All information was discuss d and questions were answered to the best of their ability. The only thing I would say is that we were told that we needed to give the permission to our usual vet to access the information, but our vet told us we need to give Medivet the permission. The information was not sent over to our vet until when we were at the appointment late afternoon and this was after myself and th vets chased this. This I would say needs to be a better system for the care of our pets.
Very friendly staff and professional approach. Highly recommended.
Very kind and attentive to our weeny feline who I am overly attached to
Very helpful and professional with my 2 very nervous cats.

I have been going to this practice for over 11 years.  Always pleased with the service received from the staff and vets.  No complaints! My dog recently had her gallbladder removed at Watford MediVet but arranged through Finsbury Park Clinic.  Seamless.
Keep up Great service as always 👍 Always GREAT care from Riana looks after my cat very well always special shout out to Sharon.. Thank you very much Team …

When making the appointment, I had requested a sedative for my cat. However, after not receiving a call back for some time, I went to the clinic in person to reiterate my request. Despite these prior requests, I was called on the day of the appointment and informed that I needed to come pick up the medication and that my appointment time had to be changed. While this situation caused me some stress, the veterinarian's attentive and friendly demeanor completely made up for these inconveniences.
All the staff there are lovely and take care of my pets really well. 100% would recommend for both dogs and cats.
Very nice and caring vet and staff looking after my cat.
Staff are lovely and always willing to help with any questions, and a calm environment for the animals. Highly recommend to anyone in need of a vet.
Really friendly and so kind to the pets

Good service seen on time, handle my dog very well he's been going there for years. All the staff know him very well and accommodate for his needs. Only thing a visit can work out very expensive especially the consultant charges.

I’ve been using the Blackstock Road, Finsbury Park Medivet for over 30 years (5 generations of cats) and the reason I always return is the friendliness of the staff. Thank you for your kind care, attention and professionalism.
My puppy is always so well looked after and everyone at the practice that I've met so far is lovely.
Really friendly and sweet team, super professional and welcoming for people and pets :)
Expert care for nervous cat.

"First time visiting with my kitten ,and the experience was absolutely fantastic. The staff were kind, professional, and made my kitten feel comfortable throughout the visit. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for excellent veterinary care

I wouldn’t know what to do without Medivet Medivet have been excellent with my dog two dogs poppy and Romeo and would highly recommend.
They will always go above and beyond for my two dogs.
Very friendly staff

Amazing practice and great staff, they really go the extra mile for your companion.

The staff there looked after our cat Gato for 17 years, beautifully. They were always helpful and when he passed away they cared. We now have Luna who had her first visit this Saturday. Once again, everyone at the practice where really great. They take their time, give advice and are helpful.
Update: it's been a year and we went back for the vaccines. The surgery has been remodelled and it feels so much nicer. The people working there are still friendly and helpful, giving good advice when needed.
Excellent and friendly practice could not praise high enough

Used to be a great vet but has sadly gone very downhill very fast. My pet has been very let down by them twice in a row now. Today they closed and didn’t notify me, came all the way here with a toddler and Very Anxious Dog to find a closed surgery. Wouldn’t have taken much to call clients to let them know, especially in this case where they know my personal circumstances.
I dread anything going wrong with my pet.  Had to take him for a sore leg.  Great vet but Very expensive 10 minutes diagnosis and advice.

Very disappointing experience with this Medivet branch.
The staff attitude was unhelpful and unfriendly. The most shocking part was receiving a sudden debt letter claiming I owe £67, even though I had never received any invoice, reminder, or explanation before this.

There was no clear communication about the charge, and instead of contacting me properly, they escalated it directly to a debt collection notice with additional fees. This is extremely unprofessional and caused unnecessary stress.

I do not recommend this clinic. Their communication is poor, their service attitude is bad, and they add unexpected charges without proper explanation.

Medivet staff are absolutely lovely, I showed up yesterday to pick up and transport a rescued pigeon from them on behalf of London Wildlife Protection and they were extremely sweet and offered a cat carrier for me to use for transportation! Also kept the pigeon safe for a prolonged period of time until I was available to transport.

It’s very meaningful to know that this organisation is open to helping all animals in London, not just our pets. Highly recommend working with them 💚

Didn't like the experience very laid back and I left with no hope for my cat. Will never return will find a different vet.

This is both my vet for work and home- I work with lots of cats and when I got my kitten I knew I wanted to sign her up for here. The staff are excellent and so incredibly friendly, I always feel like my concerns are taken very seriously and any information is explained to me clearly. I feel very secure and safe with the fantastic team here! If you are considering signing up for this practice I could not recommend it more - you will not regret it.

I’m very happy the team listens to my concerns when discussing Charle’s issues.
I always receive the right support and advice and I am extremely grateful.

My consultant was very helpful trimming down Charlie’s sides due to thick hair. I appreciated receiving advice to purchase Yumove oil to assist his dried skin and to purchase a Furminator deshedding tool. I look forward to seeing the results in due course. Thank you so much for your advice.

Vet’s medical knowledge seemed dubious and could put your pet at risk. Absolute lack of compassion. Customer service was virtually non‑existent. Avoid.

The vet had to look up (on Google, in front of me) basic breed‑related information. She pushed the most invasive (expensive) option for my 12‑year‑old dog, was rude, and the complaint response from the manager was incredibly passive‑aggressive. Sadly, my experience matched Medivet’s poor reputation.
The most kind Medivet branch ever !

My local vet it’s a friendly and safe place for my cats. Vets changed often which is a shame but they are all very knowledgeable. Defo recommend Medivet Finsbury Park branch! Reception staff it’s the best- always trying to book in when it suits me!

The vet also doubled up and did a dental check during the slot so I didn’t have to come back later, which saved me a huge deal. Wish I had signed up with them from the beginning. Nice community feel in there, another pet owner was speaking to us in reception.
